regression_notes.blob_oom_red: Two development fault probes against prior published implementation 6b0b939f5f36cb1f99718c565acd3dfbf94b9f1f showed OK/length0 on positive lazy-BLOB allocation failure. Dynamic SELECT zeroblob((random() & 0) + 4096) forces allocation during getter. Probe harness was under development, so these logs do not identify a standalone immutable reproducer revision.
regression_notes.empty_blob_red: A subsequent development probe found zero-length materialization could mutate BLOB type on allocation failure. The final fix skips pointer materialization for zero length. This log is a development regression diagnostic, not a final-source test failure.
regression_notes.fixed: Final committed tests cover SQL-generated and bound zeroblobs, size/fetch/copy getters, zero-length type preservation and empty BLOB/TEXT after another statement reports NOMEM. Every source/mode reaches an actual positive-length NOMEM on tested engines.
